hooks.command: bash -c 'd="${MIZUKARA_STANDARDS_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/mizukara-dev-standards}"; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; t() { if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then timeout "$@"; elif command -v gtimeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then gtimeout "$@"; else shift; "$@"; fi; }; g() { t 20 git "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && t 20 git -c credential.helper= -c "credential.helper=!gh auth git-credential" "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; }; }; if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then g -C "$d" pull --ff-only -q; else g clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/mizukara-corp/dev-standards.git "$d"; fi; if [ -f "$d/claude/bootstrap.sh" ]; then bash "$d/claude/bootstrap.sh"; else printf "%s" "{\"systemMessage\": \"⚠️ mizukara-standards: dev-standards の共有 clone を取得できず、必須条項・hook の判定が載っていません。対処は dev-standards の templates/target-repo/README.md「取得に失敗したとき」\", \"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"SessionStart\", \"additionalContext\": \"⚠️ mizukara-standards: dev-standards の共有 clone を取得できず、必須条項が載っていません\"}}"; fi'

bash -c 'd="${MIZUKARA_STANDARDS_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/mizukara-dev-standards}"; f="$d/claude/hooks/pre_tool_use.py"; in=$(cat); ask="{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"PreToolUse\", \"permissionDecision\": \"ask\", \"permissionDecisionReason\": \"mizukara-standards: 判定を実行できないため、マージ・push の可能性があるコマンドは確認します\"}}"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then out=$(printf "%s" "$in" | python3 "$f") || { printf "%s" "$ask"; exit 0; }; printf "%s" "$out"; else case "$in" in *merge*|*push*) printf "%s" "$ask";; esac; fi'
